tagline: Orange signal card on a charcoal gradient, set in Archivo Black with large section numbers and a breadcrumb nav.

palette.description: charcoal gradient with one saturated orange card as the focal point

typography.style: heavy grotesque display with a geometric body, numbers as navigation

best_for: Launches and pitches that need one loud focal block per slide. Works for short decks where each slide makes a single claim.
avoid_for: Quiet, text-heavy or academic material where the orange block would shout over the content.
name: Bold Signal
